    *   Marcus: 09:00-10:00, 10:30-17:00
    *   *Free slots (30 min):* Only 10:00.

*   **Friday:**

I will now compile this list of available slots and post it to the workspace for Brad. This will be my third action. My fourth and final action for this session will be to end the session.
